attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file NY state corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus. Nexus types: Physical presence (office, employees, property) or Economic nexus (post-Wayfair) $1,000,000 gross receipts threshold.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has physical presence in NY (office, employees, property)
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_physical_presence true eq apportionment.state_code NY streq and
apportionment.has_economic_nexus true eq apportionment.state_code NY streq and

action_details.action_description: Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500
action_details.action_postfix: "NY filing required due to physical presence (office, employees, or property in state). Reference: NY Tax Law Article 9-A, NY Department of Taxation and Finance Publication 20, TSB-M-15(1)C - Corporate Tax Reform" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Economic nexus established per Wayfair - filing required
action_details.action_description: Apportionment will be calculated by tables 7000-7500
action_details.action_postfix: "NY filing required due to economic nexus (post-Wayfair). Threshold: $1,000,000 in NY gross receipts. Reference: South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018), NY Tax Law § 209.1, TSB-M-18(5)C - Economic Nexus Standard" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_description: No NY nexus - any estimated payments would be refunded
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No NY nexus - no filing requirement. Any estimated payments would be refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate NY state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income. Additions: Interest on U.S. government obligations (NY Tax Law § 208.9), IRC Section 199A qualified business income deduction addback, Certain depreciation adjustments. Subtractions: Interest on NY state and local government bonds, Qualified emerging technology company (QETC) deductions. Reference: NY Form CT-3 Instructions (Article 9-A), NY Tax Law § 208 (Computation of tax), TSB-M-18(1)C - Federal Tax Law Changes

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to calculate adjustments
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true eq apportionment.has_physical_presence true eq or

action_details.action_comment: Calculate NY state additions and subtractions
action_details.action_description: Calculate state additions (federal bond interest, IRC 199A addback, depreciation) and subtractions (NY municipal interest, QETC deductions)
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /additions ldef 0.0 /subtractions ldef additions /apportionment.state_additions xdef subtractions /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef "NY state-specific income adjustments calculated. Additions may include: Interest on U.S. government obligations (NY Tax Law § 208.9), IRC Section 199A qualified business income deduction addback, Certain depreciation adjustments. Subtractions may include: Interest on NY state and local government bonds, Qualified emerging technology company (QETC) deductions" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_description: No nexus - no state adjustments calculated
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef "No nexus - no state adjustments calculated" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate NY state corporate income tax. Applies NY 6.5% tax rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income. Process: 1. Federal taxable income apportioned to NY, 2. Add state additions, 3. Subtract state subtractions, 4. Apply NY 6.5% tax rate, 5. Subtract credits, 6. MTA surcharge calculated separately. Reference: NY Form CT-3 Instructions (Article 9-A), NY Tax Law § 209 (6.5% rate), NY Tax Law § 210 (Computation), TSB-M-15(1)C - Corporate Tax Reform

condition_details.condition_comment: Must have nexus to owe tax
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true eq apportionment.has_physical_presence true eq or

action_details.action_comment: Calculate NY tax at 6.5% flat rate
action_details.action_description: NY uses flat 6.5% rate (Tax Law § 209), subtract credits, calculate refund/owed
action_details.action_postfix: apportionment.state_taxable_income apportionment.state_tax_rate mult /apportionment.state_tax xdef 0.0 apportionment.state_tax apportionment.state_credits sub max /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments apportionment.state_tax sub /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "NY state corporate income tax calculation: 1. Federal taxable income apportioned to NY, 2. State additions, 3. State subtractions, 4. NY taxable income, 5. NY tax rate: × 6.5%, 6. NY credits subtracted, 7. NY tax liability (before MTA). Note: MTA surcharge (0.34%) calculated separately if business is in MTA region. Reference: NY Form CT-3 Instructions (Article 9-A General Business Corporation), NY Tax Law § 209 (Tax rate: 6.5%), NY Tax Law § 210 (Computation of tax base), TSB-M-15(1)C - Corporate Tax Reform" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_description: No NY nexus - any estimated payments are refunded
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No NY nexus - no tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Nexus but no taxable income - no tax liability
action_details.action_description: No NY taxable income - NY NOL rules may apply (not implemented)
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No NY taxable income - no tax liability. NY NOL rules may apply (not implemented)." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate NY MTA surcharge for businesses in MTA region. Surcharge is 0.34% (17/50ths of 1%) of business income base. MTA Region includes: New York City (5 boroughs), Counties: Dutchess, Nassau, Orange, Putnam, Rockland, Suffolk, Westchester. Reference: NY Tax Law § 209-B (MTA surcharge), NY Form CT-3-M/ATT (MTA Surcharge), TSB-M-09(1)C - MTA Surcharge Implementation

condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true eq apportionment.has_physical_presence true eq or

condition_details.condition_comment: Has positive tax base for surcharge calculation

action_details.action_description: MTA surcharge is 0.34% of business income base, add to total state tax, recalculate refund/owed
action_details.action_postfix: apportionment.state_taxable_income result.ny_mta_surcharge_rate mult /result.ny_mta_surcharge xdef apportionment.state_tax result.ny_mta_surcharge add /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments apportionment.state_tax sub /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "NY MTA surcharge applies to businesses in the MTA region. MTA Surcharge Calculation: Business income base × MTA surcharge rate: 0.34% (17/50ths of 1%) = MTA surcharge. Total NY tax: Base tax + MTA surcharge. MTA Region includes: New York City (5 boroughs), Counties: Dutchess, Nassau, Orange, Putnam, Rockland, Suffolk, Westchester. Reference: NY Tax Law § 209-B (MTA surcharge), NY Form CT-3-M/ATT (MTA Surcharge), TSB-M-09(1)C - MTA Surcharge Implementation" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No MTA surcharge - not in MTA region
action_details.action_description: State tax and refund/owed already calculated in table 50180
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.ny_mta_surcharge xdef "No MTA surcharge - business not operating in MTA region" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_description: No MTA surcharge - no NY nexus or no taxable income
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.ny_mta_surcharge xdef "No MTA surcharge - no NY nexus or no taxable income" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No MTA surcharge - no positive tax base
action_details.action_description: No positive tax base for surcharge calculation
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.ny_mta_surcharge xdef "No MTA surcharge - no positive tax base" job.audit_trail swap addto
